usedFor: Pitchit holds lead insights, and an update there runs “Update Contact” in Brevo.

bestTemplate.name: “When a lead's insights are updated” in Pitchit, then “Update Contact” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: New lead insights from Pitchit reach the matching Brevo contact, so your campaigns use fresh details.

watchOut: “Update Contact” in Brevo changes an existing contact only, so the person must already be in Brevo.
